relation: two contracts over the adjacency relation, five sequence helpers by conversion: X59/X76 has_cycle_length is the RAW existence GTBase.walks_paths.has_ucycle_length (@edge_rel G) n (some MathComp ucycle of exactly n entries, no length guard: 0 always, 1 never on an sgraph, 2 exactly with an edge); X28 no_cycle_length_between is the RAW interval exclusion no_ucycle_length_between (@edge_rel G) a b (inclusive endpoints; an interval containing 0 always fails, one containing 2 excludes edges); X159 no_cycle_length_between is the GENUINE interval exclusion no_cycle_length_between (@edge_rel G) lo hi (explicit 2 < size c); X204 no_cycle_length is the GENUINE exact absence no_cycle_length (@edge_rel G) n (Boolean disequality). Raw and genuine agree only under the explicit guards 2 < n (has_ucycle_lengthE) and 2 < lo (no_ucycle_length_betweenE); no alias is redirected to the other contract. X84's same-named helper quantifies connected two-regular EDGE FAMILIES, not sequences: classified deferred without a bridge until B28, and since B29 migrated with x84_cycle_edge_set and x84_cycle_count as the separate edge-family class over Extremal.foundations.edge_cycles (edge_family_cycle, edge_family_cycle_count, has_edge_family_cycle_length; the five conjuncts in order over an arbitrary supplied family), still with no bridge to the sequence contracts.
summary: Batch B, family B15 (cycle lengths of a sequence relation): five sequence helpers now unfold, by conversion, to two contracts in `GTBase.walks_paths` over the adjacency relation `@edge_rel G`. RAW, over MathComp `ucycle` with no length guard: Extremal X59 and X76 `has_cycle_length` are `has_ucycle_length` (some ucycle of exactly n entries) and Chromatic X28 `no_cycle_length_between` is `no_ucycle_length_between` (no ucycle with between a and b entries, inclusive). GENUINE, with the explicit `2 < size c`: Chromatic X159 `no_cycle_length_between` is `no_cycle_length_between` and Chromatic X204 `no_cycle_length` is the exact absence `no_cycle_length` (a Boolean disequality). The raw contracts are preserved at EVERY parameter: raw length 0 is always witnessed by the empty ucycle, raw length 1 is impossible on a simple graph, raw length 2 is an edge, a raw interval containing 0 always fails and one containing 2 excludes edges; genuine lengths 0, 1 and 2 are impossible; reversed intervals are vacuous. The two contracts are bridged only under the explicit guards `2 < n` (`has_ucycle_lengthE`) and `2 < lo` (`no_ucycle_length_betweenE`); the rows use lengths 4..8 and X76's `3 <= k`, where they agree, but no alias is redirected.

API: raw lengths 0/1/2, genuine lengths at most 2, the guarded exact bridge; interval duality with the exact lengths (raw and genuine), the genuine exclusion through `seq_cycle`, the 0 and 2 corners, reversed and small intervals, raw-implies-genuine and the guarded converse; exact absence as the interval at identical endpoints, as negated existence and as the disequality read in Prop; on finite carriers the `#|T|` bound, and on simple graphs no raw length 1 and raw length 2 iff an edge. Groundings on K_0, K_1, K_2 and K_3 (raw 0 on the empty graph, no interval through 0 excluded; no raw 1 on a vertex; the K_2 edge as raw 2 failing the raw [2, 2] exclusion while the genuine one holds; the K_3 triangle, out-of-range 4..6 and a reversed interval). Public client base/theories/examples/cycle_lengths.v with explicit negative cases.

Six rows and one chain, frozen with this family's helpers only: Chromatic X28 (planar, no 4..6 cycles, 3-choosable), X159 (planar, no 4..8 cycles, correspondence chromatic number 3) and X204 (planar, no 4- and 5-cycles, fractional chromatic number below 11/3, with the outer uniform p, q, 0 < q and 3 * p < 11 * q); Extremal X59 (polynomial average degree forces a C4-free subgraph), X76 (C_k-free max-cut surplus, with `3 <= k`) and the cross-file X96 (large C4-free subgraph) through the frozen chain `X96Legacy.c4_free := ~ Legacy.x59_has_cycle_length G 4`. Every quantifier, guard, constant, status and document is unchanged. No proof file uses these helpers; the A5, A7 and A9 certificates that mention them recompile unchanged.

History (complete rows, over the earlier families' frozen copies, all by conversion of their own certificates): `X59Original` (A5+B15) over A5's frozen `x59_subgraph_of`; `X76Original` (A7+A9+B15, pre-M1) over A7's frozen pre-M1 count `A7.X76Original.x76_edge_count` and A9's pre-M1 cut size `A9.X76Original.x76_cut_size`, both over M1's frozen edge set; `X96Original` (A5+A7+B15) over A7's frozen raw rank count `A7.Legacy.x4_edge_count`, A5's frozen containment and the frozen chain. The eight A5/A7/A9 snapshots that keep live helpers of this family (A5 X59/X96 rows; A7 X76 and X96 Legacy and Original rows; A9 X76 Legacy and Original rows) are unchanged and documented below, with reciprocal notes for this family's per-row copies in the subgraph_of, edge_count and cut_size specs.

Classification of the same-named `Extremal.conjectures.X84.x84_has_cycle_length`: it quantifies connected two-regular EDGE FAMILIES (`x84_cycle_edge_set`, support size > 2, |F| = |support|, degree 2, connected support) and is impossible at l <= 2; the raw sequence contract is always witnessed at l = 0 and witnessed at l = 2 exactly when an edge exists, while raw l = 1 is impossible on an sgraph. It was registered in the deferred class `edge-family-exact-length`, with no bridge claimed, up to B28; B29 migrates it (see below). B11's classification of `x84_cycle_edge_set` as a distinct edge-set predicate is unchanged.

Kernel evidence, independent of this textual report, from `Print All Dependencies`: no frozen row, chain or Original reaches a live helper of this family or any of the five canonicals; the Originals also reach no live A5, A7, A9 or M1 helper or canonical; each live row reaches its canonical and its alias. Summary: /srv/graph-theory-rocq/coordination/evidence/B15-cycle_lengths/print_all_dependencies_summary.txt.

Baseline 4b63976 is a private, not-for-integration prerequisite baseline on marcol-b15-base: 8e97ca6 = B14 ed08916 + coordinator work/a9-integration 501b89f (A7, A8, A9 integrated; merge base B11 13c00aa), then 4b63976 = 8e97ca6 + the approved B12 #916 follow-up 03c25da. Conflicts were unions only (five _CoqProject files, genuine_cycle stale notes) and regenerated reports. No statement text, doc block, manifest row or leg state changes (checked below).

B29 (2026-10-04), edge-family class. Extremal X84's `x84_cycle_edge_set`, `x84_cycle_count` and `x84_has_cycle_length` are now `Extremal.foundations.edge_cycles.edge_family_cycle`, `edge_family_cycle_count` and `has_edge_family_cycle_length`, by conversion: for an arbitrary supplied family F, in order, F consists of host edges (E(G)), its support has more than two vertices, |F| equals the support size, every support vertex has incidence degree two (A10) and every two support vertices are connected by the raw relation `[set x; y] \in F`. No ambient connectivity, spanning, induced, orientation, start point or traversal condition; support and relation keep their behaviour on malformed families. The deferred class `edge-family-exact-length` becomes the migrated class `edge-family-cycles`; the sequence classes, X115, X211, U6 and B11's extraction stay separate, with no bridge claimed.

Corners in the public-only client extremal-graph-theory/theories/examples/edge_cycles.v: the empty family, K_0, K_1, K_2 and every length at most two have no cycle; K_3 has exactly one; a K_4 triangle qualifies beside an uncovered vertex with host chords outside F; two disjoint K_6 triangles are host edges but disconnected; a singleton member keeps its reflexive raw relation and is rejected by the host-edge conjunct.

Fifteen objects appended, thirty in all, thirteen complete iff: the three sources and the X84 and X85 rows at the family baseline 4b63976 (conversions); the raw support, relation and connectivity of 061154c; M1's `Legacy.edge_set` and A10's `Legacy.x84_degree_in`, bound with their owners' certificates; the raw cycle, count and length chains and the two complete pre-M1 / A10 Originals (M1's set equality `x84_edge_set_compat`, A10's conversion, pointwise row transports with the same family and witnesses). X85's natural-denominator proxy for e and every row status are unchanged. All fifteen earlier mappings and every old proof are unchanged.
